literal: Even in those born of noble family, poverty will bring a weariness that causes humiliating words to arise.
translation: Even in those born of noble birth, poverty brings a weariness of mind that gives rise to degrading words.
modern: உயர்ந்த குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களிடத்திலும், வறுமையானது இழிவான சொற்கள் தோன்றுவதற்குக் காரணமான சோர்வினை உண்டாக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the devastating psychological impact of poverty. Even individuals born into noble families, who are naturally refined in speech and conduct, are not immune to its effects. Poverty causes a deep mental weariness or lapse in self-control (cōrvu). This exhaustion weakens their resolve, leading them to utter humiliating or begging words (iḷivanda col) that they would otherwise never speak.
